description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.tldr: Adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty (e.g., Archery, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting).

features.name: Second Wind
features.tldr: You have a limited well of physical stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm, regaining hit points.

features.name: Action Surge
features.tldr: Push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment, taking one additional action on your turn.

features.name: Martial Archetype
features.tldr: Choose an archetype that you strive to emulate in your combat styles and techniques.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.tldr: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
